title: Convergence and stability of truncated Euler-Maruyama algorithm for stochastic proportional delay Mckean-Vlasov models with jump process
summary: Stochastic Mckean-Vlasov models have a substantial importance in different fields such as finance, biology and control. This paper puts the light on stochastic proportional delay Mckean-Vlasov model with Lévy jump where the non-jump coefficients are granted the permission to grow beyond linearity. The truncated Euler-Maruyama algorithm is then applied to our addressed model where the convergence rate and almost sure exponential stability of the aforementioned numerical algorithm are being investigated. Finally, numerical examples are presented to foster the theoretical analysis done…
